text: At the Swansea Town Hall Board Meeting on October 22, 2020, the Board nominated the individuals listed above for appointment by Toronto and East York Community Council to the Board of Management of the Swansea Town Hall Community Centre. Appointments to the Swansea Town Hall Community Centre Board of Management is a matter for which the Community Council has been delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision, provided that the recommendations do not vary from the Public Appointments Policy. The date of original appointment and years of service that the Board Members who are recommended for reappointment, are as follows: Jamie Anderson (March 2014, 6.75 years of service as of November 2020) Kosta Roumanis ( March 2015, 5.75 years of service as of November 2020)

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, at pleasure of Council, the individuals listed below for a 2 year term ending on November 30, 2022, and until successors are appointed: Jamie Anderson Kosta Roumanis Sarah Doucette Rob Hamilton
